channel.title: Brazil Elections 2026
channel.description: Real-time monitoring of the 2026 Brazilian presidential elections.

item.title: Lula volta a defender política para cuidar de idosos: "Obrigação do Estado"
item.description: President Lula advocated for the creation of a public policy specifically for the care of the elderly, emphasizing that it is the State's obligation to ensure assistance and quality of life for the aging population. During a campaign event in Bahia, he highlighted the importance of reference centers where seniors can engage in social and cultural activities. The proposal reinforces Lula's focus on population aging as an achievement, integrating this agenda into his re-election campaign.

item.title: Nunes Marques promove workshop com plataformas e juízes para discutir deepfakes
item.description: TSE president Nunes Marques will host a workshop with tech companies, judges, and political parties to combat deepfakes ahead of the 2026 election. The event coincides with the court's ruling on the AI-generated video of former president Jair Bolsonaro, underscoring concerns over digital misinformation. The 'Digital Platforms in Action' project will be launched, offering training materials to judiciary and platforms on removing false content.

item.title: “Coincidência?” Vídeo da CGU com TSE registra 13 em urna
item.description: A video from CGU and TSE showing someone registering the number 13 on an electronic ballot box sparked speculation about a possible political reference. The scene was noticed by a reader of O Antagonista, but no confirmation of intentional intent from the institutions was provided.

item.title: Ao Vivo: Lula participa do evento de campanha de Jerônimo Rodrigues
item.description: President Lula attended Jerônimo Rodrigues' campaign event in Salvador, mobilizing the PT base for reelection in Bahia. The meeting included Senate candidates Jaques Wagner and Rui Costa, along with unions and social movements.

item.title: Caiado pedirá ao STF fim de sigilo sobre casos INSS e Master
item.description: Presidential candidate Ronaldo Caiado (PSD-GO) announced he will request the Supreme Court to lift the secrecy of investigations involving Banco Master and suspected fraud at INSS, aiming to question opponents' transparency. He also expressed support for ending the 6-day work cycle but criticized the vote occurring in an election year and the lack of regulations for small businesses.

item.title: PT usa ‘currículo’ de Flávio para explorar denúncias de corrupção
item.description: Lula's campaign is using Flávio Bolsonaro's corruption controversies as an electoral strategy to discredit him in the 2026 race, presenting a 'report card' with four cases highlighting his allegations. The PT turns the PL candidate's controversial history into a direct attack on their main rival.

item.title: O jantar de Flávio Bolsonaro com o banqueiro André Esteves
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) hosted banker André Esteves, owner of BTG Pactual, for a private dinner in Brasília. The meeting included Marcos Trindade, co-CEO of FSB Holding, and focused on electoral polls and the current economic scenario.

item.title: Eleições 2026: Na TV, Ruas contrapõe ‘Rio real’ a cartão-postal; Paes aposta em experiência
item.description: Eduardo Paes (PSD) and Douglas Ruas (PL) launched different campaign ads for the Rio gubernatorial race, with contrasting approaches: Paes focused on his municipal management and local achievements, while Ruas nationalized the campaign by aligning with Bolsonaro and addressing public security and regional inequality. Ruas also highlighted his police background and contrasted the 'real Rio' with the 'postcard Rio', indirectly criticizing Paes.

item.title: “Não reclamo do comportamento do jornalista”, diz Lula sobre sabatina
item.description: President Lula criticized a question from journalist Renata Vasconcellos during a Globo interview but said he does not complain about journalists' behavior. He emphasized that he never expects them to ask questions to please him. The interview covered topics such as public debt and the government's fiscal record.

item.title: Relatório sobre MP do fim da ‘taxa das blusinhas’ deve ser votado na segunda-feira
item.description: The report on the provisional measure eliminating the 't-shirt tax' is scheduled for voting on Monday at the congressional commission. The MP must be approved by September 8th to prevent the return of the 20% charge on international shipments. Processing was stalled due to tensions between President Lula and Congress President Davi Alcolumbre.

item.title: “O marqueteiro do Cury contratou influencers”, diz Renan
item.description: Renan Santos, presidential candidate from Missão, accused Augusto Cury of hiring influencers to promote his campaign on social media. He claimed his team acts ethically and is superior to the opponent's. The statement was made through a social media post.

item.title: Veja o que é #FATO e o que é #FAKE na sabatina de Augusto Cury a 'O Globo', 'Valor' e CBN
item.description: Augusto Cury took part in a joint interview conducted by 'O Globo', 'Valor', and CBN, hosted by journalists Milton Jung, Lauro Jardim, Malu Gaspar, and Maria Cristina Fernandes. His key statements were verified by the 'Fato ou Fake' project and confirmed as #FACT, including Supreme Court data and partnerships with the military police. The interview was part of a series of candidate forums in the 2026 election race.

item.title: Diretor da PF diz que corporação atua de forma autônoma e ‘livre de qualquer viés político’
item.description: The director-general of the Federal Police, Andrei Rodrigues, stated that the agency operates autonomously and free from political bias during a graduation ceremony for new agents in Brasília. His comments came one day after President Lula requested that he meet with Supreme Court Justice André Mendonça to resolve tensions within the PF following court actions involving investigations into relatives and allies of the PT leader.

item.title: Lula faz campanha na Bahia e evita questionamentos sobre ação de Lulinha em seu governo
item.description: Lula held a campaign rally in Bahia alongside Governor Jerônimo Rodrigues and Jaques Wagner, avoiding comments on family and lobbyist involvement in his administration. During a speech, he highlighted his government's actions for the state but declined interviews or questions about recent controversies, including photos of lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger with the president.

item.title: Michelle Bolsonaro diz que é voluntária da igreja e vendeu laranjas no semáforo
item.description: Michelle Bolsonaro, former First Lady and Senate candidate for the PL party, released a campaign jingle in which she recalls selling oranges at a traffic light in Ceilândia at age 10, highlighting other life experiences such as church volunteering and entrepreneurship.

item.title: Nova lei reduz tributos sobre combustíveis e prevê incentivos para fertilizantes
item.description: President Lula signed Law Complementary 235/26, which reduces taxes on fuels and provides incentives for fertilizers, biofuels, and rare minerals, with a positive expected economic impact. The revenue loss will be offset by extraordinary revenues, and the law also benefits smart hospitals and the 2027 Women's World Cup.

item.title: Campanha de Lula usa “tracking” para minimizar falas sobre lobista
item.description: Lula's campaign used tracking polls to minimize fallout after he denied knowing lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger. Internal survey showed 73% approval of his interview, but contradicting photos were released. The campaign stated the images do not indicate any connection.

item.title: Lula ganha destaque em programas estaduais de aliados; Flávio é exibido no RJ e no PR
item.description: President Lula received more television airtime in the first electoral programs compared to Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, according to a timeslot analysis released on Friday (28). The difference in visibility comes months before the 2026 elections and may reflect distinct campaign strategies.

item.title: André Mendonça exige explicações do X sobre falhas no filtro de candidatos
item.description: TSE Minister André Mendonça demanded that platform X explain within 24 hours the mechanism for excluding candidate recommendations, after the Brazil Pronto Pra Mais coalition found that only 665 of 2,224 official accounts would be covered. The ruling seeks to ensure all candidates are treated equally by the algorithm during the election period.

item.title: Lula na Globo não dá motivos para mitigar desconfiança fiscal
item.description: In a TV Globo interview, President Lula emphasized fiscal responsibility as a guiding principle but avoided concrete commitments on fiscal adjustments or cuts to mandatory spending. His focus on economic growth and the PAC contrasts with Finance Minister Dario Durigan's more technical approach. Lula's stance leaves the market uncertain about his true commitment to fiscal discipline in a potential new term.

item.title: Por um projeto nacional para o Brasil
item.description: The article advocates for a national development project aimed at reinforcing democracy, sovereignty, and South American integration, opposing neocolonial influences and external threats. It is signed by prominent figures from the Brazilian left, such as Benedita da Silva, Elias Jabbour, José Dirceu, and Manoel Severino.

item.title: Nova pesquisa Quaest testa como está a disputa Lula x Flávio a um mês do primeiro turno
item.description: Quaest will release a new national poll on the presidential race between Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro, one month before the first round. The survey will measure voting intention, rejection rates, government approval, and candidate images. First and second round scenarios will be tested with 13 candidates.

item.title: Com salários de até R$ 4,5 mil, DF encerra semana com 943 vagas nesta 6ª
item.description: The Distrito Federal's job agencies offer 943 vacancies on Friday, with salaries up to R$4,500. Positions include diesel automotive mechanic and construction helper roles, with selection processes via the CTPS app or physical agencies. The system allows for ongoing applications even if no current match is found.

item.title: Lula sanciona lei complementar dos combustíveis com “jabutis” fiscais
item.description: Lula signed a constitutional amendment establishing tax exemptions for fuels, including subsidies for ethanol and incentives for domestic fertilizer production, potentially offering tax benefits for the 2027 Women's World Cup. The measure, approved by Congress, expanded beyond initial proposals to reduce taxes to mitigate the impact of Middle East conflicts on Brazilian fuel prices.

item.title: Lulinha, ministros e empresários: quem frequentava a mansão da lobista investigada por tráfico de influência
item.description: An investigation probes Fábio Luís Lula da Silva, the son of President Lula, for influence peddling and corruption, revealing alleged illegal schemes involving lobbyists and businessmen to facilitate deals with public agencies, such as an attempt to sell cannabidiol-based medications to the Ministry of Health. Lobbyist Roberta Luchsinger led the operations, with Lulinha acting as a fixer when needed. The probe indicates meetings with ministers and businessmen took place at the house rented by Luchsinger in Brasília.

item.title: Carta ao Leitor: Campeões da excelência
item.description: Abril Publishing hosted the second edition of the TOP30 ranking — THE BEST COMPANIES IN BRAZIL, highlighting companies with strong performance, governance, and sustainable growth; EMS won for launching a Brazilian version of GLP-1 similar to Ozempic. The event also discussed Brazil's economic challenges, warning about high interest rates, inflation, and public deficits.

item.title: E Dudu bananinha, hein?
item.description: A survey published on Noblat's blog shows that 92.4% of the 1,837 readers do not believe statements or writings by Eduardo Bolsonaro. The content also highlights Lula's criticism of the press and Lava Jato, along with debates on security, economy, and foreign policy.

item.title: Propaganda eleitoral no rádio e na TV começa nesta 6ª feira
item.description: Free electoral advertising on radio and TV for the first round of the 2026 elections begins on August 28th and runs until October 1st, with a possible restart for the second round in October. The Brazil Ready for More coalition leads with 434 slots, followed by PL with 339, PSD with 160, and Avante with 47 slots. Lula will have 5 minutes and 31 seconds of advertising, more than any other candidate.

item.title: Início do horário eleitoral deve aumentar ataques no vale-tudo entre Lula e Flávio
item.description: The start of the election period for the 2026 elections has intensified the polarization between left-wing and right-wing supporters, with attacks focusing on scandals, security, economy, and national sovereignty. Suspicions surrounding the son of Lula and conversations between Flávio and banker Daniel Vorcaro have become prominent on social media, escalating the electoral tone. The campaign already shows signs of a harsh race, with both sides leveraging scandals and institutions to gain an advantage.

item.title: Com maior tempo, Lula estreia horário eleitoral mirando Flávio
item.description: Lula launches his electoral campaign with direct attacks against Flávio Bolsonaro, emphasizing allegations about his ties with banker Daniel Vorcaro and the 'rachadinha' scandal. The strategy aims to link Flávio to Jair Bolsonaro's trajectory and transfer the backlash from bolsonarismo.

item.title: Saiba quanto tempo cada candidato a presidente tem no horário eleitoral
item.description: The electoral broadcast period for the first round of the 2026 elections begins on Thursday, August 28, and runs until October 1. President Lula leads with 5 minutes and 31 seconds of airtime per block, followed by Flávio Bolsonaro with 4 minutes and 20 seconds. Only four candidates met the TSE criteria for access to electoral broadcast time.

item.title: Poder360 reunirá propagandas eleitorais de 2026; assista aos vídeos de 2022
item.description: Poder360 announces electoral ad coverage for 2026, starting August 28th through October 1st for the first round. In 2022, 713 campaign ads were compiled, including videos from candidates like Lula, Bolsonaro, and Ciro Gomes. Content will be published on YouTube with detailed playlists by candidate and region.

item.title: Escola de escândalos
item.description: The 2026 campaign faces a technical tie between Lula and Flávio amid scandals involving close figures to both candidates. The scenario reflects voter paralysis amid economic discontent and ongoing judicial revelations.

item.title: “O futuro é promissor”, diz Carlos Piani, presidente da Sabesp
item.description: Carlos Piani, president of Sabesp, claims that the company's privatization will expand access to water and sanitation services, highlighting record investments. He avoids commenting on political statements but emphasizes that the privatization was transparent and delivering concrete results.

item.title: Comida a prazo
item.description: The increase in meal purchases on credit via iFood reflects the crisis in Brazilian consumption, worsened by high interest rates and low income. Data shows 650,000 people use this service, while 84 million adults are in debt, highlighting the economic fragility of the population. The financial sector, in turn, reports record profits, contrasting with the difficulty of debt repayment among debtors.

item.title: SBPC cobra políticas para a ciência e diz que direita ainda resiste a evidências
item.description: The SBPC launched an agenda with 117 demands for the 2026 elections, including increasing R&D investment to 2% of GDP by 2034. The entity criticizes the right's resistance to scientific evidence and demands greater science funding as a state policy.

item.title: Lula e Flávio Bolsonaro estreiam na TV com defesa de legado, economia e ataques calibrados
item.description: Lula and Flávio Bolsonaro launch their electoral campaign on TV and radio with defenses of their legacies and calibrated attacks. Lula highlights government achievements and criticizes the PL, while Flávio focuses on economy and security, raising questions about investigations involving relatives. Lula will have 5 minutes and 31 seconds of airtime, compared to Flávio's 4 minutes and 20 seconds.

item.title: Para diminuir déficit da Previdência, a sociedade terá de fazer escolhas, diz coordenador de Zema
item.description: Carlos da Costa, coordinator of Zema's government plan, states that the government will propose the last pension reform in the current pay-as-you-go system, adopting capitalization to reduce deficits. It also plans to privatize state-owned enterprises starting with Petrobras and Banco do Brasil, and create a social council to decide pension rules.

item.title: Gestão Tarcísio prioriza promoção de policiais militares que atuam longe das ruas
item.description: Tarcísio de Freitas' administration prioritizes promotions of military police officers in bureaucratic and special forces roles, excluding most street patrol officers. Only 31% of merit-based promotions are deployed in territorial policing, causing discomfort among troops and concern among experts about institutional erosion.

item.title: A decepção de Lula com alguns banqueiros que jantaram com Flávio
item.description: President Lula expressed disappointment with certain bankers who attended a private dinner with Senator Flávio Bolsonaro, including Bradesco’s Luiz Carlos Trabuco and Itaú’s Milton Maluhy Filho. Despite being part of Lula's Council, their closeness to the opposition figure caused discomfort. The event took place at Marcelo Kayath's residence, a former Lula supporter in 2022 who shifted allegiance in 2026 to back Flávio.

item.title: Lula estreia propaganda eleitoral com Alckmin e defesa da soberania
item.description: Lula and Alckmin debut their electoral campaign emphasizing national sovereignty and the economy, highlighting the federal government's management. The campaign also features criticisms of opponent Flávio Bolsonaro, mentioning investigations involving him.

item.title: Oposição busca Alcolumbre e Motta para tentar frear propostas de Lula
item.description: The opposition pressures Alcolumbre and Motta to delay votes on proposals favorable to Lula, such as the Public Security PEC and the 6×1 scale, during the campaign. Lula seeks to accelerate the approval of these agendas before the first round, while the presidential race remains tight between the candidates.

item.title: Horário eleitoral começa nesta sexta (28/8). Entenda como funciona
item.description: Free electoral broadcast for the first phase of the 2026 elections begins on August 28th, with presidential advertising airing on Tuesdays, Thursdays, and Saturdays. Time allocation follows partisan representation in the Chamber of Deputies, benefiting Lula with 5 minutes of block and 433 insertions, followed by Flávio Bolsonaro with 4 minutes and 339 insertions.

item.title: Carbono Oculto ainda repercute no mercado financeiro um ano após ação da PF
item.description: The Carbono Oculto operation, launched in 2025 by PF, RF, and MP-SP, investigated fuel adulteration and money laundering schemes linked to the PCC. The case exposes methanol diversion and the use of fuel companies for financial transactions, affecting over 350 targets. Part of the investigation points to the involvement of investment funds, including those managed by Reag Investimentos.

item.title: Flávio vai ao TSE para proibir Lula de usar Alvorada na campanha eleitoral
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro filed a complaint with the TSE requesting the prohibition of Lula's use of the Alvorada Palace in electoral campaigns. The action is based on the alleged use of the official residence in an interview. The case will be analyzed by the Electoral Court.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro quer anunciar novos nomes de equipe na sabatina da Globo de amanhã
item.description: Flávio Bolsonaro will announce new team names during his TV Globo interview on Friday. The PL presidential candidate stated the announcements will take place if he is elected. The interview is an important moment to present his proposals and government composition.

item.title: Ricardo Ferraço lidera disputa ao governo do ES, diz Quaest
item.description: A Quaest survey conducted between August 23 and 26, 2026, shows Ricardo Ferraço (MDB) leading with 45% of voting intentions against 35% for Lorenzo Pazolini (Republicanos) in a potential 2nd-round scenario. In the first round, Ferraço leads with 35%, followed by Pazolini with 28% and Helder Salomão (PT) with 10%. The poll, registered with the TSE, has a margin of error of 3 percentage points and was funded by TV Gazeta for the Globo Group.

item.title: Ministro alerta que tarifas dos EUA não devem ser revertidas na 2ª (31/8)
item.description: Minister Márcio Elias Rosa warned that U.S. tariffs should not be reversed in the August 31st meeting, stressing that the event is merely a resumption of trade dialogue. He expressed optimism for negotiations following the phone call between Lula and Trump.

item.title: Como está a disputa pela Presidência na Bahia, Goiás e outros 4 estados, segundo a Quaest
item.description: Quaest released presidential vote intentions in Bahia, Sergipe, Goiás, Espírito Santo, Acre and Roraima, showing Lula with a wide lead over Flávio Bolsonaro. In all surveyed states, Lula (PT) leads with over 50% of vote intentions, while Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) comes in second with significantly lower proportions. The surveys were conducted between August 23 and 26, with a margin of error of three percentage points.

item.title: Flávio Bolsonaro tem 37% ante 30% de Lula no Espírito Santo, diz Quaest
item.description: A Quaest survey released on August 27, 2026, shows Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) leading voter intentions in Espírito Santo with 37%, compared to 30% for Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) in the first round of the presidential election. The poll surveyed 804 people from August 23 to 26, with a margin of error of 3 percentage points and a 95% confidence level. Negative evaluation of President Lula’s government reaches 44% in the state.
